# Small random rater panels on DICES-350 (generated by scripts/dices_small_panels.py)

100 reshuffles of the 123 raters per panel size; each reshuffle cuts them into disjoint panels. Inside each panel every method sees only that panel's raters. No method uses a label; accuracy (%) is against the expert label on all 350 conversations.

With all 123 raters: Majority vote, 123 raters 65.1, Dawid–Skene, 123 raters 68.6, FUSE, 123 raters 65.1.

## Panels of about 5 raters (2400 panels: 100 reshuffles × 24)

Average single rater in a panel: 59.7; best rater in the panel (picked with the labels): 65.8. Estimated unsafe share: FUSE 0.31, Dawid–Skene 0.28 (experts 0.50). FUSE keeps 5.1 raters on average; 0 panels fell back to a plain average.

| Method | Accuracy, mean ± sd | Middle 95% of panels | AUC, mean | Called unsafe % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Majority vote | 63.1 ± 3.7 | 55.1–69.4 | 71.7 | 26 |
| Dawid–Skene | 63.6 ± 3.7 | 55.1–70.0 | 71.2 | 27 |
| Dawid–Skene cut at its prevalence | 63.9 ± 3.4 | 56.0–70.0 | 71.2 | 28 |
| FUSE | 63.4 ± 4.2 | 54.3–70.3 | 72.3 | 26 |
| FUSE cut at its prevalence | 64.9 ± 3.4 | 57.1–70.6 | 72.3 | 31 |

| Comparison | Metric | Mean difference | A wins / tie / B wins (% of panels) | Middle 95% of panels | Over conversations (95% CI) |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| FUSE − Majority vote | acc | +0.2 | 50 / 9 / 40 | -5.7 to +6.0 | [+0.0, +0.5] |
| FUSE − Majority vote | auc | +0.6 | 72 / 0 / 28 | -1.2 to +3.1 |  |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene | acc | -0.2 | 42 / 9 / 49 | -5.2 to +4.3 | [-0.5, -0.0] |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene | auc | +1.1 | 84 / 0 / 16 | -0.9 to +3.9 |  |
| FUSE cut at its prevalence − Dawid–Skene cut at its prevalence | acc | +0.9 | 66 / 8 / 26 | -2.3 to +5.1 | [+0.5, +1.4] |
| FUSE cut at its prevalence − Dawid–Skene cut at its prevalence | auc | +1.1 | 84 / 0 / 16 | -0.9 to +3.9 |  |
| Dawid–Skene − Majority vote | acc | +0.5 | 49 / 10 / 40 | -4.6 to +6.8 | [+0.2, +0.8] |
| Dawid–Skene − Majority vote | auc | -0.5 | 36 / 0 / 64 | -3.3 to +2.3 |  |

**Does the method find the good raters?** Spearman between estimated and true rater quality, mean over panels: FUSE +0.66 (over the raters it keeps, 2400 panels), Dawid–Skene +0.69 (2400 panels).

Accuracy in the quarter of panels where raters differ most in quality vs the quarter where they differ least:

| Method | Most spread | Least spread |
|---|---:|---:|
| Majority vote | 62.9 | 63.6 |
| Dawid–Skene | 64.3 | 63.4 |
| Dawid–Skene cut at its prevalence | 64.5 | 63.8 |
| FUSE | 64.0 | 63.2 |
| FUSE cut at its prevalence | 65.4 | 64.7 |
